lines.en: label chinamidate15:
I tap on Chinami’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Chinami 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: : Hihi! Chinami’s phone. This is Chinami’s secretary speaking.
lines.zh: : 嗨嗨!这里是 Chinami 的电话。我是 Chinami 的秘书。

lines.en: : Chika?
lines.zh: : Chika?

lines.en: : Does this mean you’re not working at the mall anymore?
lines.zh: : 这是不是说你不在商场上班了?

lines.en: : Heheh~ Of course I am. This is just an unpaid internship.
lines.zh: : 呵呵~ 当然在。这只是个无薪实习。

lines.en: : So what’s up? Calling to check on my little sister?
lines.zh: : 那怎么了？打电话来关心我妹妹?

lines.en: : Sure, let’s go with that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，就当是这样吧。

lines.en: : Well, you’re in luck! Cause we’re actually having ourselves a little pool party right now and Chinami would be suuuuuuper excited if you showed up!
lines.zh: : 那你运气不错!因为我们这会儿正在办一场小小的泳池派对，你要是能来，Chinami 会超——级开心的!

lines.en: : How are you having a pool party without a pool?
lines.zh: : 没有泳池，你们怎么办泳池派对?

lines.en: : We actually {i}do{/i} have a pool. It’s just one of those cheap, blow-up ones that we keep stashed away in the closet for most of the year.
lines.zh: : 我们{i}确实{/i}有泳池。就是那种便宜的充气泳池，一年里大部分时间都塞在柜子里。

lines.en: : And...what better time to break it out than the middle of winter?
lines.zh: : 而且……还有什么比大冬天更适合把它拿出来的时候吗?

lines.en: : Right!
lines.zh: : 对吧!

lines.en: : Chika, that was sarcasm.
lines.zh: : Chika，那是反话。

lines.en: : Your face is sarcasm. Come get wet with my sister and me.
lines.zh: : 你脸上才是反话。来跟我和我妹妹一起湿身吧。

lines.en: : Chika, please don’t add Chinami into sentences like that.
lines.zh: : Chika，别把 Chinami 加进那种句子里。

lines.en: : Come stop me, then!
lines.zh: : 那你来阻止我啊!

lines.en: : Bye bye, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 拜拜，Sensei!

lines.en: : Chika-
lines.zh: : Chika——

lines.en: scene black
Well, it looks like I am apparently starting today off with a...spontaneous pool party?
lines.zh: 看来我今天显然要以一场……临时泳池派对开场了?

lines.en: I slide my phone into my pocket and begin to make my way over to the bus stop.
lines.zh: 我把手机塞进口袋，动身往公交站走去。

lines.en: I feel as if just showing up to an event like this is going to require a fair amount of energy, so I should probably be conserving all I possibly can...
lines.zh: 光是出席这种活动就感觉要耗掉不少精力，所以大概该尽可能攒着力气……

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty1
: Hey! Great timing. I just dried myself off.
lines.zh: : 嘿!来得早不如来得巧。我刚把自己擦干。

lines.en: : How is that great? What happened to getting wet with you and your sister?
lines.zh: : 这巧在哪儿？跟你和你妹妹一起湿身呢，怎么不提了?

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty2
: What happened to not wanting to drag the wizard into any of our silly euphemisms?
lines.zh: : 是谁说不想把巫师拖进我们那些蠢比喻里的?

lines.en: : Touché.
lines.zh: : 说得妙。

lines.en: : You really didn’t have to go and do something like that, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你真没必要搞这么一出。

lines.en: : Don’t let me being here stop you from having fun.
lines.zh: : 别因为我在这儿就扫了你们的兴。

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty3
: Ehh...I was starting to get kind of hungry anyway.
lines.zh: : 嗯……反正我也开始有点饿了。

lines.en: : Besides, Yumi is still in the pool with Chinami, so it’s not like she’s totally alone.
lines.zh: : 再说 Yumi 还在泳池里陪着 Chinami，所以她也不算完全一个人。

lines.en: : Yumi...is in a kiddie pool?
lines.zh: : Yumi……在儿童泳池里?

lines.en: : Yumi is in a kiddie pool.
lines.zh: : Yumi 在儿童泳池里。

lines.en: scene black
: Excuse me, Chika. I need to see this with my own eyes.
lines.zh: : 失陪一下，Chika。我得亲眼看看。

lines.en: : Heheh~ Don’t stare too hard when you’ve already got me, okay?
lines.zh: : 呵呵~ 你都有我了，别盯着看太久，好吗?

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty4
I walk into the living room slash bedroom to find that Yumi is, indeed, in a kiddie pool.
lines.zh: 我走进客厅兼卧室，发现 Yumi 果然在儿童泳池里。

lines.en: And apparently having a pretty good time, too.
lines.zh: 而且看样子还玩得挺开心。

lines.en: : Thank you for all of the business tips, big sis Yumi! It makes Chinami very happy to learn about management from an experienced professional!
lines.zh: : 谢谢 Yumi 姐姐的经商建议!能跟着经验丰富的专业人士学管理，Chinami 非常开心!

lines.en: : Hey, I ain’t {i}that{/i} experienced, twerp. Just know who you’re tryin’ to sell to and things’ll take care of themselves.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我可没{i}那么{/i}有经验，小鬼。只要搞清楚你在卖给谁，剩下的自然会解决。

lines.en: : In that case, may I interest you in Chinami-Corp's latest product? It’s just like a normal giraffe, but it has a jetpack and can shoot lasers out of its eyes.
lines.zh: : 那样的话，Chinami 公司的最新产品您有兴趣吗？就跟普通长颈鹿一样，只不过装了喷气背包，还能从眼睛里射激光。

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty5
: Heh. Will you take an IOU? I’m still kinda searchin’ for something a little more...predictable in the finance department.
lines.zh: : 嘿。能打欠条吗？我在财务上还在找一份更……稳定的东西。

lines.en: : But I feel like I’ve been gettin’ pretty close lately and-
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得最近已经挺接近了，而且——

lines.en: : Papa!
lines.zh: : 爸爸!

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty6
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : What’d I tell you about payin’ attention to people when they’re talkin’ to you?
lines.zh: : 我怎么跟你说的，别人跟你说话的时候要专心?

lines.en: : Sorry, big sis Yumi! Chinami was just so excited to see her favorite man in the whole wide world!
lines.zh: : 对不起，Yumi 姐姐!Chinami 只是太高兴见到全世界她最喜欢的男人了!

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty7
: The hell are you talkin’-
lines.zh: : 你他妈在说什么——

lines.en: : Hey.
: Fancy meeting you here.
lines.zh: : 真巧，在这儿遇见你。

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty8
: Wha...
: Did big sis Chika tell you about the pool party, Papa? Or are you just here to pick up an order you placed on Chinamicorp.com?
lines.zh: : 是 Chika 姐姐告诉你泳池派对的事吗，爸爸？还是说你只是来取你在 Chinamicorp.com 下的订单?

lines.en: : This...
lines.zh: : 这个……

lines.en: : It’s...not what it looks like!
lines.zh: : 这……不是你看起来的那样!

lines.en: : You’re not enjoying yourself and teaching Chinami about business inside of a kiddie pool in your best friend’s house?
lines.zh: : 你不是在好朋友家里的儿童泳池里，一边享受一边教 Chinami 做生意吗?

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty9
: I...I was makin’ sure the water wasn’t too hot for her! She’s got sensitive skin!
lines.zh: : 我……我只是确认一下水对她来说不会太烫!她皮肤敏感!

lines.en: : Chinami’s skin isn’t very sensitive. Her mommy used to say it was strong and smooth just like {i}her{/i} mommy’s before she went to Heaven.
lines.zh: : Chinami 的皮肤并不敏感。妈妈以前说过，它又结实又光滑，就像{i}她{/i}妈妈的皮肤一样，在她去天堂之前。

lines.en: : Whatever! Now that I know it’s fine...my job here is done!
lines.zh: : 随便吧!既然知道没事了……我在这儿的任务就完成了!

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty10
: No! Come back! It’s not a family pool party unless we’re all here!
lines.zh: : 不行!回来!我们都到齐了才算家庭泳池派对!

lines.en: : Chinami finally found happiness!
lines.zh: : Chinami 终于找到幸福了!

lines.en: : Wait, Yumi. You’re not actually going out dressed like that, are you?
lines.zh: : 等等，Yumi。你不会真要穿成这样出门吧?

lines.en: : When the alternative is hangin’ around and being watched by that guy, heck yes I’m going out like this!
lines.zh: : 既然另一个选择是留下来被那家伙盯着看，那我当然要穿成这样出门!

lines.en: : Just...tell me when he’s gone or something! I don’t know!
lines.zh: : 那……等他走了什么的再告诉我!我也不知道!

lines.en: : Yumi! Come on!
lines.zh: : Yumi!别走!

lines.en: : Sensei! Watch Chinami for a sec, please!
lines.zh: : Sensei!帮我看一下 Chinami，拜托!

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty11
I turn around to watch Chika quickly throw a hoodie on and chase Yumi out the door.
lines.zh: 我转过身，看着 Chika 匆匆套上连帽衫，追着 Yumi 出了门。

lines.en: Then, within a matter of seconds, there are two pantless girls wandering around the old district of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 于是，几秒钟之内，就有两个没穿裤子的姑娘在 Kumon-mi 老城区游荡。

lines.en: : Darn it.
lines.zh: : 可恶。

lines.en: : It’s fine. We can have a pool party with just the two of us.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我们俩也能开泳池派对。

lines.en: : Yeah. But if either one of them catches a cold, they’ll have to quarantine themselves and Chinami will spend a few days alone.
lines.zh: : 嗯。可要是她们俩谁感冒了，就得自我隔离，那 Chinami 就得一个人待好几天。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, worse comes to worst, you can come stay at my house for a few days.
lines.zh: : 嗯，实在不行的话，你可以来我家住几天。

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty12
: Do you have a puppy?!
lines.zh: : 你有小狗吗?!

lines.en: : No. But I have a [niece] who kind of acts like one sometimes.
lines.zh: : 没有。不过我有个[niece]，有时候挺像小狗的。

lines.en: : Is she fluffy?
lines.zh: : 她毛茸茸的吗?

lines.en: : Not really. No.
lines.zh: : 算不上。不毛。

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty13
: Chinami really wishes you had a puppy. That would give her the incentive she needs to come visit and avoid catching a cold from her dumbo sisters.
lines.zh: : Chinami 真希望你养只小狗。那样她就有动力来做客，也不用被她那俩笨蛋姐姐传染感冒了。

lines.en: : Well that’s just too bad then because I don’t want a puppy.
lines.zh: : 那可太遗憾了，因为我不想养狗。

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty14
: Hmph. I guess big sis Yumi was right after all and you really {i}don’t{/i} have a heart.
lines.zh: : 哼。看来 Yumi 姐姐说得对，你真的{i}没有{/i}心。

lines.en: : Sure I do. It’s just not bogged down with the thoughts of love and puppies. It’s doing its job and delivering blood throughout the rest of my body.
lines.zh: : 我当然有。只是没被什么爱啊小狗啊的念头拖累。它好好干着本职工作，把血输送到我全身。

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty15
: Boooooring. Chinami wants to talk about dogs.
lines.zh: : 好——无聊。Chinami 想聊狗。

lines.en: : This is the worst pool party I’ve ever been to.
lines.zh: : 这是我参加过最糟的泳池派对。

lines.en: : Because Chinami is poor and can’t afford a real pool?
lines.zh: : 因为 Chinami 很穷，买不起真正的泳池?

lines.en: : Just wait until she’s a famous CEO princess with a hundred dogs that all hate you.
lines.zh: : 等着瞧吧，等她成了有名的 CEO 公主，养一百只全都讨厌你的狗。

lines.en: scene black
Despite wanting a hundred dogs to hate me or whatever ill will Chinami is suddenly wishing upon me, she scoots her way over to the edge of the pool and looks up at me.
lines.zh: 尽管她盼着有一百只狗讨厌我、或者说突然对我起了各种恶意，她还是挪到泳池边上，抬头看着我。

lines.en: I can already tell she’s switching modes once again- the same way I’ve seen her do a few times in the past.
lines.zh: 我已经能看出来，她又切换模式了——就像我过去几次见过的那样。

lines.en: I don’t want to say that she’s putting on an act or something- in fact, I’m almost positive she’s not.
lines.zh: 我不想说她是在演戏什么的——事实上，我几乎可以肯定她不是。

lines.en: But for someone like her, someone who’s able to understand and acknowledge exactly how she’s different from everyone else-
lines.zh: 但对她这样的人，一个能清楚理解并承认自己跟别人有多不同的人——

lines.en: There is always another mode.
lines.zh: 总会有另一种模式。

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty16
: Do you know why we’re having a pool party today?
lines.zh: : 你知道我们今天为什么办泳池派对吗?

lines.en: : No idea, actually.
lines.zh: : 说实话，不知道。

lines.en: : You should have all just gotten into the bath together if you were going to do something like this indoors.
lines.zh: : 既然要在室内搞这个，你们干脆一起泡澡不就好了。

lines.en: : Big sis Chika and big sis Yumi felt bad for Chinami because she can’t go to the beach with all of the other girls.
lines.zh: : 因为 Chinami 不能跟其他女孩一起去海边，Chika 姐姐和 Yumi 姐姐觉得她可怜。

lines.en: : So they tried to bring the beach to her instead.
lines.zh: : 所以她们想把海滩搬到她面前。

lines.en: : But Chinami wishes they could have brought their other friends here, too.
lines.zh: : 可 Chinami 希望她们把别的朋友也带来。

lines.en: : Chinami’s heard so much about them.
lines.zh: : Chinami 听说了好多关于她们的事。

lines.en: : Not from Yumi, I imagine.
lines.zh: : 我想不是从 Yumi 那儿听来的。

lines.en: : She’s not exactly the most popular kid at[school].
lines.zh: : 她在[school]里可算不上最受欢迎的孩子。

lines.en: : That’s because big sis Yumi is misunderstood.
lines.zh: : 那是因为 Yumi 姐姐被误解了。

lines.en: : But if Chinami were her age and got to go to[school] with everyone, she’d tell them that big sis Yumi isn’t scary at all.
lines.zh: : 可如果 Chinami 是她那个年纪，能和所有人一起去[school]，她一定会告诉大家 Yumi 姐姐一点都不可怕。

lines.en: : I’m sure your actual sister has tried that on multiple occasions.
lines.zh: : 我相信你亲姐姐已经试过好多次了。

lines.en: : Some people just aren’t really cut out for more than one or two interpersonal relationships, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我想，有些人天生就应付不来超过一两段人际关系。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t know what inner-personal means, but she’d like to try anyway.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不知道「内在人际」是什么意思，不过她还是想试试。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, Chinami will probably never get to go to a real[school], so we’ll never find out.
lines.zh: : 可惜 Chinami 大概永远上不了真正的[school]，所以永远不会知道了。

lines.en: : Giving up on your dreams of being a “normal girl” already?
lines.zh: : 这么快就放弃当「普通女孩」的梦想了?

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty17
: Chinami thinks that maybe some people just aren’t really cut out for being “normal girls” she guesses.
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得，也许有些人天生就不是当「普通女孩」的料吧，她猜。

lines.en: : After Chinami’s new papa bought her a smartphone, she looked up all sorts of stuff about her condition.
lines.zh: : Chinami 的新爸爸给她买了智能手机之后，她查了各种关于自己病情的资料。

lines.en: : She wasn’t very pleased with what she read.
lines.zh: : 她看到的东西让她很不高兴。

lines.en: : You should probably just be using your phone to murder pigs and leaving all of that sad stuff to medical professionals.
lines.zh: : 你还是该拿手机去杀猪，那些让人难过的事交给专业医生就好。

lines.en: : The problem with the Internet and self diagnoses is that a person’s illness is never really as cut and dry as a list of symptoms on paper.
lines.zh: : 网络自诊的问题在于，一个人的病从来不像纸上列出的症状清单那样一清二楚。

lines.en: : In order to have whatever is wrong with you properly discovered, you need to gather the opinions of people who have spent their life training in the field and-
lines.zh: : 要真正查出自己身上出了什么问题，你得听取那些穷尽一生在这个领域受训的人的意见，而且——

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty18
: Chinami is bored again.
lines.zh: : Chinami 又无聊了。

lines.en: : You’re not very good with girls, are you Papa?
lines.zh: : 爸爸，你不太擅长跟女孩子相处吧?

lines.en: : Well...I don’t think I’m {i}bad{/i} with them.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我觉得我还不{i}算差{/i}。

lines.en: : Even though you have nothing you like to talk about and say all that boring stuff about doctors?
lines.zh: : 明明你没有任何喜欢聊的话题，还净讲些关于医生的无聊东西?

lines.en: : You know what? Why don’t we go back to talking about you?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？我们还是聊回你吧。

lines.en: : Is Papa afraid of doctor Chinami’s professional analysis? She has spent years training in the field.
lines.zh: : 爸爸是怕 Chinami 医生的专业分析吗？她可是花了好多年在这个领域训练的。

lines.en: I suppress the urge to hold Chinami’s head underwater and sigh to myself, knowing that she’s likely just trying to get a rise out of me at this point.
lines.zh: 我压下把 Chinami 的头按进水里的冲动，暗自叹了口气——我知道她到这会儿大概只是想惹我而已。

lines.en: But even with the half-jokes about self diagnoses and her apparent side job as a medical professional, I really do feel for her.
lines.zh: 不过就算有那些关于自诊的半开玩笑的话、还有她那副兼职医生的样子，我是真的心疼她。

lines.en: I’ve never been good with empathy or sympathy or whatever {i}pathy{/i} the average person would exercise at a time like this-
lines.zh: 我从来不擅长共情、同情，或者随便什么普通人在这时会运用的{i}情{/i}——

lines.en: But I do wish things would have turned out a little bit different for her.
lines.zh: 但我确实希望，她的结局能稍微不一样一点。

lines.en: Not that things are “over” yet by any means.
lines.zh: 倒不是说事情已经「结束」了，远远没有。

lines.en: But maybe some day this wizard will learn to use her powers to change herself and not just anyone she comes into contact with.
lines.zh: 不过也许有一天，这个巫师会学会用她的力量改变自己，而不只是改变她接触到的任何人。

lines.en: Perhaps she could even change me.
lines.zh: 也许她连我都能改变。

lines.en: : Doubtful.
lines.zh: : 不大可能。

lines.en: : Doubtful?
lines.zh: : 不大可能?

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. Was just thinking out loud.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。我只是把心里话说出来了。

lines.en: : About what?
lines.zh: : 关于什么?

lines.en: : Chinami wants to hear what you think about while you talk to her so she can be sure she didn’t make you feel bad.
lines.zh: : Chinami 想知道你跟她说话的时候心里在想什么，这样她才能确定自己没让你难过。

lines.en: : Chinami is in for a rude awakening then.
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami 可要有心理准备了。

lines.en: : You probably don’t realize this since you spend your entire life trapped inside of this house, but people very rarely say what they’re thinking in conversation.
lines.zh: : 你大概意识不到，因为你一辈子都困在这屋子里——人在谈话时极少会说出自己真正在想什么。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : Because we all have thoughts and parts of ourselves that we want to keep hidden.
lines.zh: : 因为我们都有想要藏起来的念头、藏起来的那一面。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : Because people would realize how ugly we were if we actually expressed them.
lines.zh: : 因为要是真说出来，别人就会知道我们有多丑陋。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : Please don’t do this, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 别这样，Chinami。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: if ami_virgin == False:
I’ll be sure to cite things like this the next time Ayane or Ami tell me they want babies.
lines.zh: 下次 Ayane 或 Ami 说想要孩子的时候，我一定要把这种事搬出来当论据。

lines.en: else:
I’ll be sure to cite things like this the next time Ayane talks about having a baby.
lines.zh: 下次 Ayane 提起要孩子的时候，我一定要把这种事搬出来当论据。

lines.en: : Are you just doing this to terrorize me?
lines.zh: : 你这么做就是为了折腾我吧?

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty19
: Yup.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : Chinami realized she was annoying you, so she decided to distract you by annoying you in a different way.
lines.zh: : Chinami 发现自己在烦你了，所以决定换个方式烦你，好让你分心。

lines.en: : Chinami was not “annoying me.”
lines.zh: : Chinami 并没有「烦我」。

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty20
: Then how come your eyebrows looked like this?
lines.zh: : 那你的眉毛为什么是这个样子?

lines.en: : I don’t know. Maybe I’m just not good at talking to you?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。也许我就是不擅长跟你说话?

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty21
: That’s true. But we already figured that out when you wanted to talk about doctors and stuff.
lines.zh: : 这倒是。不过你想聊医生什么的那个时候，我们就已经发现了。

lines.en: : Well forgive me for wanting you to be a little more hopeful about your future.
lines.zh: : 那恕我多嘴，我只是希望你对自己的未来乐观一点。

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty22
: Chinami...
lines.zh: : Chinami……

lines.en: : Chinami has no future.
lines.zh: : Chinami 没有未来。

lines.en: : Or at least not the kind of future her sisters and their future husband do.
lines.zh: : 至少没有她姐姐们和她们未来的丈夫会有的那种未来。

lines.en: : First off, you do have a future.
lines.zh: : 首先，你确实有未来。

lines.en: : Secondly, I can’t marry both of them. I’m pretty sure that sort of thing is illegal in Japan.
lines.zh: : 其次，我不能同时娶她们俩。我很确定这种事在日本是违法的。

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty23
: Does that mean you’ll marry {i}one{/i}?!
lines.zh: : 那意思是你会娶{i}其中一个{/i}?!

lines.en: : What? No.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。

lines.en: : Which one?!
lines.zh: : 哪一个?!

lines.en: : Big sis Chika would be a better wife but big sis Yumi’s body is more womanly.
lines.zh: : Chika 姐姐会是更好的妻子，不过 Yumi 姐姐的身材更有女人味。

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty24
: Ah! You’re not thinking of marrying Chinami, are you?!
lines.zh: : 啊!你该不会在想娶 Chinami 吧?!

lines.en: : Uhhhhh...excuse me?
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……你说什么?

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty25
: Yay! Big sis Chika is home!
lines.zh: : 耶!Chika 姐姐回来了!

lines.en: : Welcome back.
lines.zh: : 欢迎回来。

lines.en: : I take it you weren’t able to track down Yumi?
lines.zh: : 看来你没追上 Yumi?

lines.en: : Ugh, no. She’s annoyingly fast when she wants to be...and I didn’t want to run around barefoot.
lines.zh: : 唉，没有。她想跑的时候快得气人……而且我也不想光着脚到处跑。

lines.en: : Would you mind explaining to me why you’re suddenly going to marry my little sister, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你能解释一下，你为什么突然要娶我妹妹了吗?

lines.en: : Sorry for stealing your boyfriend, big sis! Chinami is just too darn cute.
lines.zh: : 对不起抢了你的男朋友，姐姐!Chinami 就是太可爱了嘛。

lines.en: : She can't help it if things like this happen.
lines.zh: : 这种事发生的话，她也没办法。

lines.en: : Chika, it is not what it sounds like.
lines.zh: : Chika，不是你听起来的那样。

lines.en: : I never agreed to any of this.
lines.zh: : 我从来没答应过任何这类事。

lines.en: : She’s forcing it on me.
lines.zh: : 是她硬塞给我的。

lines.en: : She’s four feet tall.
lines.zh: : 她才四英尺高。

lines.en: : But has the personality of a giant.
lines.zh: : 可性格像个巨人。

lines.en: : And the immune system of scrambled eggs!
lines.zh: : 还有炒蛋一样的免疫系统!

lines.en: : Chinami! Stop that!
lines.zh: : Chinami!别闹了!

lines.en: scene chinamipoolparty26
: Chinami is sorry. Please forgive her.
lines.zh: : Chinami 知错了。请原谅她。

lines.en: : And also make her lunch because she’s worked up an appetite from all of her swimming.
lines.zh: : 还有，请给她做午饭，因为她游了泳，胃口大开。

lines.en: scene black
Chika reluctantly agrees to her sister’s demands and winds up making lunch for all three of us.
lines.zh: Chika 勉强答应了妹妹的要求，最后给我们三个都做了午饭。

lines.en: We wind up eating together while the Chosokabes soak in their kiddie pool and I, being the anti-fun human being that I am, remain to the side of them.
lines.zh: 我们一起吃了饭，长宗我部姐妹泡在她们的儿童泳池里，而我这个人天生扫兴，就待在她们旁边。

lines.en: Yumi never comes back and probably catches a cold or something. I don’t know.
lines.zh: Yumi 再也没回来，大概感冒了什么的。我不知道。

lines.en: Either way, it’s a little worrying to hear that Chinami now has access to a plethora of information that’ll likely exacerbate her already worrisome outlook on her condition.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，听说 Chinami 现在能接触到海量信息、很可能会让她本就令人担忧的病情观更糟，这多少让人有些担心。

lines.en: But I think she’s counting herself out a little early, personally.
lines.zh: 不过我个人觉得，她把自己淘汰得太早了。

lines.en: Is she weaker than everyone else? Sure.
lines.zh: 她比别人虚弱吗？确实。

lines.en: I can’t recall {i}ever{/i} having to wear an animal mask in public while...that’s just a normal thing for her.
lines.zh: 我可记不起来自己{i}有哪一次{/i}需要在公共场合戴动物面具，而……那对她来说却是家常便饭。

lines.en: But she’s still alive.
lines.zh: 可她还活着。

lines.en: She just needs to be a little careful.
lines.zh: 她只是需要多小心一点。

lines.en: $ chinamidate15 = True
$ chinami_love += 1
{i}Chinami’s affection has increased to [chinami_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chinami 的好感度提升到了 [chinami_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
